verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, and a desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and screen access is a fair capability to ask of that kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes Poke as living in messaging channels (Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS) and documents no official desktop app, no OS-level shortcuts and no screen access. The right-click "Send to Poke" example on the API docs page is an API-driven integration, not a first-party desktop app, so it earns no credit.
